whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Studio Of Martial Arts,

I noticed your martial arts studio has stellar 4.8★ reviews with 240+ happy students in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new class inquiries.

Maine aapke studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial class booking, batch timings, aur student reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/studiomartialarts

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Studio Of Martial Arts team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke martial arts studio ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial class booking and mobile-first speed for Kankarbagh parents and students. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact batch timings aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
